question.text: Roshni Trust is registered on NSE-SSE but has not yet raised funds through ZCZP or any listed instrument. As per Regulation 91E, the AIR for Roshni Trust shall be:

answer.text: Assessed by an empanelled SIA on a reasonable-assurance basis.
Self-certified annual impact report covering the NPO's significant activities and explaining the methodology for determining significance.
Waived entirely until the first listing.
Filed only upon receipt of a SEBI notice.

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 91E(2A) and the SEBI framework provide that an NPO only registered on SSE without raising funds shall submit a SELF-CERTIFIED AIR covering significant activities, with the NPO explaining the methodology for significance. The SE also enjoys a two-year non-raise window before de-registration triggers. The Trap: External SIA assessment is required only for LISTED projects. Waiver / notice-contingent filing both miss the self-certified annual obligation. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII Topic 6 (Listing / Registration) and Topic 9 both test this - a registered-but-not-listed NPO still files a self-certified AIR. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When an NPO client is registered but pre-raise, offer an 'advisory-only' engagement (not an assurance engagement) to help them prepare the self-certified AIR and document the significance methodology. A clean two-year preparatory cycle positions them for a stronger first ZCZP raise.
